About the café

A place to linger, not rush

Unhurried tables, something sweet always on the counter, and a corner that's yours for a small celebration.

🍳

Brunch, done slowly

Brunch plates, fresh toast, eggs and coffee — the kind of morning you don't want to end.

🍰

Desserts & coffee first

Cakes, sweet treats and proper coffee are the heart of the café. Dessert is not an afterthought here.

🍸

Evenings & private dining

Settle in for cocktails as the day winds down, or book the private space for birthdays and small gatherings.

Gallery photos are illustrative for this demo — they will be replaced with Cafe de Plaza's own photos on the live site.

Private dining & parties

Birthdays, get-togethers & small celebrations

Cafe de Plaza lists private dining among its offerings — ideal for a birthday table, a family get-together, or a quiet celebration with dessert at the centre.

  • A separate, more private space for your group
  • Dessert & cake at the heart of the celebration
  • Brunch, coffee or evening cocktails — your call
  • Confirm group size, date and menu on one phone call
